posts.description:
We are rather fond of brass. And, as it turns out, people have been for a very long time.

From Roman coins and Georgian chandeliers to Art Deco lamps and contemporary lighting, brass has spent roughly two thousand years proving just how adaptable it can be. Polished, brushed or left to mellow into a warm patina, it brings character wherever it goes.

Our Language of Materials guide takes a wander through its history, craftsmanship and enduring place in the home, with plenty of lovely lighting along the way.

Pour yourself something nice and have a read.

Natural wonders, with a rather lovely glow.

Our wooden lighting collection brings warmth, texture and sculptural character into a room, with natural materials doing what they do best: making everything feel a little softer and more settled.

The Stave pendant is a particularly handsome example, with its layered wooden form bringing just enough presence above dining tables, kitchen spaces and anywhere that could do with a more tactile focal point.

Have a browse through the Natural Wonders collection and discover lighting that lets the material do the talking.

Give your favourite pieces the spotlight they deserve.

A well-placed picture light can turn a painting, photograph or print into the focal point of a room, casting a warm, flattering glow that does wonders after dark. From the sculptural Clyfford and Pitcheroo in antiqued brass to Pixii's rechargeable design (no wiring required), there's a finish and fitting for every kind of frame.

It's a small addition that makes a surprisingly big difference, especially now the evenings are starting to draw in.

Have a browse through the range and find the light your favourite piece has been waiting for.

The favourites everyone keeps coming back to.

Some lights just have a knack for stealing the show, and these are the pieces our customers can't stop falling for. From the endlessly versatile Twinky rechargeable table lamp to statement pieces like the Athena chandelier and ever-popular ceramic bases like Stucco and Ambrose, these are the designs that turn up in living rooms, hallways and bedrooms again and again.

There's a reason they're loved: proper craftsmanship, an art for making a room feel finished, and just the right amount of character.

Have a browse through our most loved lights and see which one earns a permanent place in your home too.

New term, new glow.

September's creeping closer, and there's nothing like a proper desk lamp to make the return to books (or the back-to-work slump) feel a little more civilised.

Our rechargeable desk lights are wonderfully good company: cordless, quick to charge, and just as at home on a console table as they are lighting up a stack of homework. Think warm brass hoods, cheerful colours, and a glow that makes even the dullest to-do list look rather more appealing.

Whether it's a studious corner, a home office, or a desk that's been begging for an upgrade all summer, there's a Pooky lamp that knows how to set the mood.

Have a browse and find the desk light that makes getting down to work feel a little less like a chore.

Brighten up your bookcase.

Rechargeable shelf lights are a wonderfully easy way to give your favourite books, bits and pieces their moment in the spotlight.

They are particularly good on shelves, bookcases and those awkward little corners where a cord would only get in the way. Warm, portable and pleasingly unfaffy, they bring a cosy glow exactly where it is needed and make the whole thing look far more considered.

Have a little browse and see which one your shelves have been waiting for.

Evening glow, but make it rather lovely.

Extend your summer evenings in the garden with outdoor lighting that keeps the mood going, from spike lights in the hedgerows to lanterns on the walls and charming little glows for the table.

The right outdoor lights are awfully good at making a garden feel settled after dark. Perfect for those moments when supper drifts into drinks and nobody is quite ready to go in yet.

Have a browse through the range and find the piece that keeps your garden glowing a little longer.

Our Summer Sale is here to brighten up the season.

The prettiest picks of the summer are now up to 70% off selected lines, which feels like a rather good excuse to revisit anything that may have been waiting in your favourites.

From characterful lamps and cheerful shades to those lovely finishing touches that make a room feel more settled, there is plenty to browse. Whether you are refreshing a corner, rethinking a whole room, or simply in the mood for something bright and charming, now is a very good time to have a look.

Have a little wander through the sale and see what catches your eye before it disappears.

A new lampshade can do quite a lot with very little effort.

Same lamp base, entirely different mood. Softer, brighter, bolder, calmer: it all changes with one rather clever switch.

From pleated favourites to printed beauties and timeless neutrals, our lampshades are awfully good at bringing personality to a room without a full redesign.

Go on. Your lamp may be ready for a new outfit.

Novogratz x Pooky has arrived, and it’s awfully good fun.

Created with Bob and Cortney Novogratz, this cheerful new collection brings together playful colour, portable outdoor lighting and a wonderfully easy sort of summer style.

Think rechargeable pieces designed for gardens, terraces and alfresco tables, along with shades full of pattern, warmth and personality. It is all about making outdoor spaces feel more inviting, more expressive, and much better dressed for long lunches and evenings that drift on rather nicely.

Portable, charming and full of character, this is lighting made for outdoor entertaining with a little more joy in it.

Have a browse through the range and see what catches your eye.
